summary: iPlus-MES is a .NET 10 / Avalonia SCADA+MES whose OEE is per-production-run and not ISO 22400 (SQL Server only, no Postgres found), with OPC-UA and Modbus implemented in the separate iPlus framework repo, weak security defaults (None and Anonymous OPC-UA endpoints, auto-accepted certificates, plaintext DB credentials, documented default logins), no unit-test project and no PR CI gate.

d1_oee.formula: TotalOEE = Availability x Performance x Quality (iPlusMES/gip.mes.datamodel/EntityFacility/FacilityMaterialOEE.cs, CalcOEE). Availability = OperationTimeSec / (OperationTimeSec + UnscheduledBreakTimeSec), 1 if OperationTimeSec is 0. Performance = Throughput / FacilityMaterial.Throughput, capped at 1, where Throughput = Quantity x 3600 / OperationTimeSec. Quality = (Quantity - QuantityScrap) / Quantity.
d1_oee.storage: SQL Server table FacilityMaterialOEE (EF model iPlusMES/gip.mes.datamodel/EFModels/FacilityMaterialOEE.cs). One row per production interval (StartDate/EndDate) per FacilityMaterial, with time buckets in seconds (IdleTimeSec, StandByTimeSec, OperationTimeSec, ScheduledBreakTimeSec, UnscheduledBreakTimeSec, RetoolingTimeSec, MaintenanceTimeSec), Quantity, QuantityScrap, Throughput and the four OEE values. Rollups in iPlusMES/gip.mes.facility/Model/OEE/FacilityOEEAvg.cs and ACFacilityOEEManager.cs (GetOEE). Period granularity is the variable run interval, not a fixed bucket.
gaps: TotalOEE uses (x > double.Epsilon ? x : 1) for each factor, so a factor of 0 (for example 100% scrap, Quality = 0) or a negative factor is silently counted as 1. This is a correctness defect.
Only Performance is capped at 1. Availability, Quality and TotalOEE are not clamped to [0,1], and Quality is not floored at 0 when scrap exceeds quantity.

Availability denominator is operating time plus unscheduled break only. Idle, standby, retooling, maintenance and scheduled break are excluded from planned time, which is not ISO 22400 planned busy time.
Performance uses a historical average throughput (RecalcThroughputAverage: latest 500 rows with availability above 0.99), not an ideal cycle time.
FacilityOEEAvg averages the ratios with equal weight (sum / count), not weighted by time or quantity.
GenerateTestOEEData in ACFacilityOEEManager.cs writes synthetic rows through the production code path.

d2_downtime.model: ISA-S88 process-object state per PA object: ACStateEnum in iPlus/gip.core.autocomponent/ACProcessApplication/ACPAClass/ACStateEnum.cs (framework repo, not iPlusMES). Workflow substates in iPlusMES/gip.mes.processapplication/ACProcessWorkflow/PWMethod/ACSubStateEnum.cs are bit flags. OEE time is accumulated into buckets on FacilityMaterialOEE, not a state-period table.
gaps: No running/idle/fault/offline enum. ISA-S88 states (SMIdle, SMRunning, SMHeld, SMAborted, ...) do not map 1:1 to GreyHook states, and there is no fault or offline state.
Downtime categories are fixed time buckets. No reason-coded downtime catalog was found.
No per-state period table with transition timestamps was found in the sampled code.
No explicit mapping from ACStateEnum to the OEE time buckets was found in the sampled code.

protocols: OPC UA client and server: iPlus/gip.core.communication/PLC/OPC/OPCUA/ (OPCUAClientACSession.cs, OPCUAClientACSubscr.cs, OPCUASrvServer.cs), configured by OPCUAClient.Config.xml and OPCUAServer.Config.xml. Uses subscriptions with PublishingInterval, not polling.
OPC UA security: server config offers SignAndEncrypt_3 with Basic256Sha256, but also None_1, Sign_2 and an Anonymous_0 user token policy.
d3_device.edge_arch: No separate edge gateway. OPC UA and Modbus run inside the .NET process (desktop, console or service host) on the same hosts as the MES. No Kafka or MQTT files were found in the iPlusMES tree.
d3_device.write_guard: None evident. OPCUAClientMonitoredItem.OnSendValueToOPCServer (iPlus/gip.core.communication/PLC/OPC/OPCUA/OPCUAClientMonitoredItem.cs) calls WriteAsync whenever a bound ACProperty changes. The only gate is a resend lock. The writable guard (_IsWriteable) is commented out at lines 60 and 76.
gaps: Server config comments that the no-security option was removed, yet None_1 and an Anonymous_0 token policy are still enabled.
AutoAcceptUntrustedCertificates is true in both OPCUAClient.Config.xml (line 81) and OPCUAServer.Config.xml (line 41).
No PLC write allowlist and no read-only default for machine connectivity.
OPCUAClientACSession.cs supports OPCUserAuthenticationMode.Anonymous as a selectable mode.

d4_data_model.hierarchy: Facility and FacilityMaterial > FacilityMaterialOEE. Process objects sit in the ACClass/ACProject application tree, with ACProgram and ACProgramLog entities. Company and CompanyAddress hold business partners.
d4_data_model.shift_model: CalendarShift and CalendarShiftPerson entities (iPlusMES/gip.mes.datamodel/EntityCalendar/CalendarShift.cs, CalendarShiftPerson.cs), linked to ACProject. No shift-pattern or OEE-by-shift logic was found in the sampled files.
d4_data_model.telemetry_schema: No fixed telemetry schema and no time-series store (no TimescaleDB). OEE rows are per-run records in SQL Server. Process data is recorded as ACProgramLog and ACProgramLogPropertyLog, driven by property changes.
d4_data_model.tenancy: None. One database per installation. No organization_id or tenant column in the sampled entity FacilityMaterialOEE. Company is a business partner, not a tenant.

d5_api.versioning: None evident. No versioned route was found. PAJsonServiceHostVB is a WCF-style JSON host with no version segment.
d5_api.realtime: No SignalR or WebSocket found. Real-time comes from the framework's network-transparent RMI and OPC UA subscriptions.
d5_api.envelope: WSResponse<T> wrapper carrying a Msg (level and text).
d5_api.auth: Session-based with SessionID per request. README documents default logins superuser/superuser (client) and 00/00 (service). MCP host uses ApiKey scheme. No JWT, OAuth or Windows-auth evidence found.

d6_ai.model: Default google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free via OpenRouter. Provider types are OpenAICompatible, OpenAI and Ollama. Not Anthropic.
gaps: MCP tools: 7 runtime tools in MCPIPlusTools.cs and 15 dev_* tools in MCPIPlusDevTools.cs. Several are write-capable, including create_new_instance, dev_add_method and dev_save_changes. None is read-only.
execute_acurl_command is a generic command executor, not parameterized query tools.
No rate limiting found in BSOChatBot_LLM.cs. Only HTTP timeouts configured.
No audit logging: no logger calls in MCPIPlusTools.cs, MCPIPlusDevTools.cs or PAMCPServerHost.cs.
Auth is a single ApiKey scheme with no per-user or tenant scoping.
LLM ApiKey stored as a plain string property with no encryption at rest.

d7_quality.tests: No unit or integration test project in iPlusMES. gip.bso.test is a manual BSO test harness with no test SDK reference. The iPlus framework has two unit test projects.
d7_quality.ci: .github/workflows/release.yml only: runs on tags v* and workflow_dispatch, builds binaries, creates GitHub release. No PR build or test gate.
d7_quality.migrations: No EF Core migrations. Schema changes applied as ~27 SQL scripts in iPlusMES/gip.mes.datamodel/DbScripts/iPlusMES/dbsync_YYYY-MM-DD_*.sql (2025-2026). No down scripts.
security_flags: README documents default logins superuser/superuser (client) and 00/00 (service).
OPC UA AutoAcceptUntrustedCertificates=true with None and Anonymous endpoints enabled.
Database backups committed: Database/iPlusMESV5.7z and Database/IPCDrivesV5.7z.
Strong-name key committed at repo root: GIP-SNKey.snk (may contain private key).

adopt: Subscription-based OPC UA monitored items with PublishingInterval instead of polling.
Declarative OPC UA security policy list in XML config.
Per-run OEE rows that store time buckets and four ratios, allowing recomputation and drill-down (CalcOEE pattern).
Config-driven release signing modes in release.yml.
avoid: Silent 0-to-1 substitution in TotalOEE (x > double.Epsilon ? x : 1).
Unweighted averaging of OEE ratios across rows (FacilityOEEAvg).
Historical-average performance in place of ideal cycle time.
OPC UA None and Anonymous endpoints, AutoAcceptUntrustedCertificates=true, and unguarded WriteAsync on any property change.
Plaintext DB credentials in ConnectionStrings.config, default superuser/superuser logins, and committed DB backups.
Write-capable MCP tools with a single ApiKey and no audit logging.
differentiate: ISO 22400 OEE with planned busy time, ideal cycle time, [0,1] clamp, and time-weighted rollups. Add organization_id to every row (iPlusMES has no tenancy).
Machine states running/idle/fault/offline with reason-coded downtime catalog and state-period table (iPlusMES uses ISA-S88 with no fault or offline).
OPC UA SignAndEncrypt only, no None or Anonymous, certificate validation enforced, read-only by default.
AI read-only, rate-limited, audited and tenant-scoped through parameterized tools with claude-sonnet-4-6 (iPlusMES tools are write-capable and unaudited).
Postgres with TimescaleDB for telemetry and Kafka/Temporal for streaming/workflows (iPlusMES is SQL Server row-based, no time-series store).
